nodes.name: Precipitation of Co-Co PBA NCs
nodes.procedure: Co₃[Co(CN)₆]₂ nanocubes (Co-Co PBA NCs) were prepared by precipitation (see the Supporting Information for details).
nodes.source_text: Co₃[Co(CN)₆]₂ nanocubes (Co-Co PBA NCs) were prepared by precipitation followed by chemical etching...

nodes.name: Chemical Etching to Co-Co PBA NFs
nodes.procedure: Co-Co PBA NCs were converted into Co-Co PBA NFs by chemical etching in an ammonia solution.
nodes.source_text: Co₃[Co(CN)₆]₂ nanocubes (Co-Co PBA NCs) were prepared by precipitation followed by chemical etching in an ammonia solution to give the nanoframe structure (Co-Co PBA NFs).

nodes.name: Phosphidation to CoP NFs
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared Co-Co PBA NFs solid was converted into CoP NFs by a low-temperature phosphidation method (see the Supporting Information for details).
nodes.source_text: The as-prepared solid was converted into CoP NFs by a low-temperature phosphidation method...

nodes.name: Direct Phosphidation to CoP NCs
nodes.procedure: CoP nanocubes (CoP NCs) were synthesized by direct phosphidation of Co-Co PBA NCs.
nodes.source_text: the CoP nanocubes (CoP NCs) were synthesized by direct phosphidation of Co-Co PBA NCs...

nodes.name: Sulfuration to CoS₂ NFs
nodes.procedure: When Co-Co PBA NFs samples were used as precursors, simple sulfuration methods were used to prepare the CoS₂ nanoframes (CoS₂ NFs).

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP NFs show orthorhombic phase of CoP (JCPDS no. 29-0497).
nodes.evidence_snippet: A low-temperature phosphidation treatment for the Co-Co PBA NFs gave an orthorhombic phase of CoP (JCPDS no. 29-0497), Figure S3A.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP NFs maintain nanoframe morphology with slight surface roughening and numerous small nanoparticles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SEM images show that in the CoP NFs product, the nanoframe morphology is maintained but with a slight surface roughening and the appearance of numerous small nanoparticles (Figures 2A,B and S4).

properties.description: Scanning Electron Microscopy image labeled E

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP NFs show nanoframe morphology with small pores on roughened surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM images of CoP NFs are also consistent with the nanoframe morphology (Figure 2C,D) with small pores on a roughened surface.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP NFs show lattice fringes with d-spacing of 0.28 nm indexed to (011) crystal plane of CoP.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image of the CoP NFs in Figure 2E, there is evidence for lattice fringes with a d-spacing of 0.28 nm, which can be indexed to the (011) crystal plane of CoP.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP NFs SAED pattern shows bright rings from (011), (111), (211), and (301) crystal planes of orthorhombic CoP.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern in Figure 2F includes several bright rings that arise from the (011), (111), (211), and (301) crystal planes of an orthorhombic CoP structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP NFs show uniform distribution of Co, P, C, and N throughout the nanoframe.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The corresponding energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopic (EDX) elemental mapping images reveal that Co, P, C, and N are uniformly distributed throughout the nanoframe (Figure 2G).

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP content in CoP NFs is 49.5 wt%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The weight percentage of CoP in the CoP NFs was determined by inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES). Analysis of the working curve gave 49.5 wt% of CoP in the CoP NFs (Figure S5).

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP NFs XPS shows Co 2p3/2 at 778.8 eV and Co 2p1/2 at 793.7 eV for Co-P species, P 2p3/2 at 129.1 eV and P 2p1/2 at 130.2 eV for CoP, with binding energy shifts relative to metallic Co and elemental P.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The characteristic Co 2p3/2 and Co 2p1/2 peaks of Co-P in CoP appear at 778.8 and 793.7 eV, respectively. ... the high-resolution P 2p XPS spectrum can be deconvoluted into three peaks with a doublet at 129.1 and 130.2 eV arising from P 2p3/2 and P 2p1/2 of CoP ... compared with metallic Co (778.1 eV) and elemental P (130.0 eV), the binding energies for Co 2p3/2 and P2p3/2 are positively and negatively shifted.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP NFs Brunauer-Emmett-Teller surface area is 52.5 m²/g; CoP NCs is 28.3 m²/g.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Figure S9, the Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) surface area of CoP NFs is 52.5 m²g⁻¹, which is higher than the value 28.3 m²g⁻¹ for CoP NCs.

nodes.characterization_summary: Electrochemical double-layer capacitance Cdl for CoP NFs is 32.4 mF/cm² and for CoP NCs is 7.8 mF/cm² in 0.5 M H₂SO₄.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Cdl for CoP NFs was 32.4 mF cm⁻², which is a considerable increase compared to CoP NCs at 7.8 mF cm⁻².

nodes.characterization_summary: CoS₂ NFs show lattice fringes of 0.27 nm for (200) plane; CoSe₂ NFs 0.26 nm for (210) plane; CoTe₂ NFs 0.28 nm for (111) plane.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Lattice fringes of 0.27, 0.26, and 0.28 nm were clearly observed (Figure 6C,F,I) and attributed to the crystal planes, CoS₂(200), CoSe₂(210), and CoTe₂(111), respectively.

properties.description: Right inset showing lattice fringes with square nanoparticle

nodes.characterization_summary: CoS₂ NFs BET surface area 45.9 m²/g; CoSe₂ NFs 37.6 m²/g; CoTe₂ NFs 34.2 m²/g.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The BET surface areas for CoS₂ NFs, CoSe₂ NFs, and CoTe₂ NFs were 45.9, 37.6 and 34.2 m² g⁻¹ (Figure S17), respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: In 0.5 M H₂SO₄, electrochemical double-layer capacitance Cdl values are CoS₂ NFs 27.5 mF/cm², CoSe₂ NFs 20.9 mF/cm², CoTe₂ NFs 13.8 mF/cm².
nodes.evidence_snippet: In 0.5 M H₂SO₄, the Cdl for CoS₂ NFs, CoSe₂ NFs, and CoTe₂ NFs were 27.5, 20.9, and 13.8 mF cm⁻² (Figure S18), respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoP NFs show amorphous carbon matrix for CoP nanoparticles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: An amorphous carbon matrix is also formed for the CoP nanoparticles as shown by the Raman spectrum in Figure S3B.
